nodes.label: Lux Anchor Mechanism
nodes.description: Tier 3-4 secret: Dawnborn are living containers for ritual anchor energy; releasing it kills them but restores the sun

nodes.label: Four-Tier Knowledge System
nodes.description: Common/Informed/Expert/Campaign Secret tiers for 8 topics; Tiers 3-4 contain ritual and Dawnborn secrets; three-clue rule governs revelation

nodes.label: Three-Clue Rule
nodes.description: GM principle: each Tier 3-4 secret has three independent clue paths so players can reach it multiple ways

nodes.label: Knowledge Tiers
nodes.description: Four-tier information system document; 8 topics with DC tables; Tier 3-4 secrets; three-clue rule

hyperedges.label: Knowledge-Tier-Revelation System
hyperedges.description: The four-tier knowledge system gates the campaign's central secret (Lux Anchor / Dawnborn as living ritual containers) behind three independent clue paths, with the Deep Archive's Corven documents as the primary Tier 4 source
